ScriptItem.Title: autocatalytic_rate
ScriptItem.ScriptText:
import math
CA = R1 CW = R2 CP = P1
k_nc = 2.50e-5 * math.exp(-46000.0 / 8.314 * (1.0/T - 1.0/313.15)) k_cat = 9.83e-2 * math.exp(-29700.0 / 8.314 * (1.0/T - 1.0/313.15))
Ka = 1.8e-5 Cw_r = 55.5 H3O = math.sqrt(Ka * max(CP, 1e-9))
r = (k_nc + k_cat * H3O / Cw_r) * CA * CW with open(r"C:\Users\bihan\OneDrive\Desktop\dwsim_debug.txt", "a") as f: f.write(f"CA={CA}, CW={CW}, CP={CP}, T={T}, r={r}\n")
